description.value: A family-run farm market operating since 1980 on King Road in Abbotsford, the Berry Barn is the produce and berry arm of Neufeld Farm Market. They grow their own strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, and blueberries on-site, hand-picked daily in season, and also stock Okanagan fruit, everyday produce, meats, seafood, and soft ice cream. A touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley can load up on fresh local fruit and staple groceries here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active farm market in Abbotsford (not Chilliwack as OSM community suggests) selling home-grown berries, fresh produce, meats, and other grocery items. The OSM phone (+1-604-859-0484) matches the 'Produce/Berries' line on the contact page. No evidence was found on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities. The website's product categories (berries, everyday produce, chicken & turkey, beef & pork, seafood, appetizers, sweets & treats) clearly support a Basic groceries classification.
concerns: OSM community is listed as Chilliwack but the website consistently identifies the location as Abbotsford, BC
OSM record has no address; website shows 32215 King Rd, Abbotsford, BC V2T 5Z4
The Berry Barn is one section of the larger Neufeld Farm Market operation; there may be a separate OSM entry for the main market
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active farm market selling fresh produce, berries, meats, and other groceries — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.
